certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Excel with Copilot: AI-Assisted Spreadsheets

learning_outcomes.text: Explain what an AI assistant in Excel can and cannot do, and where a human must verify
Prompt an assistant to generate formulas, explain existing formulas and suggest fixes
Ask for data summaries, trends and suggested PivotTables, then confirm them against the data
Use AI to draft chart and formatting choices while keeping the message honest
Recognise risks: hallucinated functions, wrong ranges, data privacy and over-reliance
Build a verification habit so AI output is always checked before it drives a decision

integrative_case: A business analyst adopts an AI assistant in Excel to speed up a weekly report: they prompt it for formulas and a PivotTable, catch a hallucinated function and a wrong range, remove an over-stated chart axis it suggested, and add a verification checklist before the numbers go to the manager.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
